```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(future)
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(plotly)
library(gtools)

#plan("cluster", workers = 5)
options(future.globals.maxSize = Inf)

data_dir <- "/omics/groups/OE0436/data/lena/output/"
raw_dir <- "/omics/groups/OE0436/data/karina/BrM_Xenium/Jonathans_files"
fig_dir <- "/omics/groups/OE0436/data/lena/output/figures/"

infile <- file.path(data_dir, "3_xenium_BroadCellTypes.RDS")
xenium <- readRDS(infile)
xenium

infile <- file.path(raw_dir, "BrM_TLS_cellbarcodes.csv") 
tls_region <- read.csv(infile)

```

# subset to only tls containing cells

```{r}
TLScells <-  subset(xenium_BroadCellTypes, subset = tls.status == "1")
unique(Idents(TLScells))
ImageDimPlot(TLScells)

TLScells <- SetIdent(TLSregions, value = "tls_region")
ImageDimPlot(TLScells)
```

# add tls cluster info as meta data

```{r}
tls_regionDF <- tls_region %>% 
  select(cell_barcode, TLS_nb)
  
tls_cells <- data.frame(cell_barcode = colnames(TLScells))

new_df <- left_join(tls_cells, tls_regionDF, by = "cell_barcode")
new_df[is.na(new_df)] <- 0

tls_region <- new_df["TLS_nb"]
rownames(tls_region) <- make.unique(as.character(new_df$cell_barcode))

TLScells <- AddMetaData(object = TLScells, metadata = tls_region, col.name = "tls_region")

TLScells$tls_region <- factor(TLScells$tls_region, 
                               levels = mixedsort(unique(TLScells$tls_region)))#save as factor and use mixedsort so that the order is TLS1, TLS2... instead of TLS1, TLS10...

plot <- ImageDimPlot(TLScells, size = 0.3)

ggsave(plot, file = paste0(fig_dir,"6_TLScluster_celltypes", ".png"), width = 12, height=12)

saveRDS(TLScells, file = file.path(data_dir, "6_TLSregions.RDS"))
```
!!!ehfpckdp-1 has both TLS4 and TLS5 annotation
!!!kpgjojen-1 has both TLS5 and TLS10 annotation

```{r}
TLScells <- SetIdent(TLScells, value = "tls_region")
unique(Idents(TLScells))

# Extract metadata from Seurat object
metadata <- TLScells@meta.data 

# Count the number of cells for each cell type in each TLS cluster
cell_counts <- metadata %>%
  group_by(tls.cluster, annotationRes0.3) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop')

# Calculate proportions
cell_counts <- cell_counts %>%
  group_by(tls.cluster) %>%
  mutate(proportion = count / sum(count))

# Plot
plot <- ggplot(cell_counts, aes(x = tls.cluster, y = proportion, fill = annotationRes0.3)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(x = "TLS Cluster", y = "Proportion", title = "Cell Type Proportion in TLS regions") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(vjust = 10, size = 10)) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3")
ggsave(plot, file = paste0(fig_dir,"6_CelltypesInTLSregion", ".png"), width = 10, height=8) 

```


# Analyze TLS clusters 

```{r}
#check whether meta data was stored correctly
table(TLScells@meta.data$tls.cluster)

#convert TLS cluster information from character into a factor
TLScells$tls.cluster <- factor(TLScells$tls.cluster, 
                               levels = mixedsort(unique(TLScells$tls.cluster)))
#set tls.cluster as active Ident (we also have the cell types)
Idents(TLScells) <- TLScells$tls.cluster
levels(TLScells)
```



```{r}
library(plotly)
centroid_coords <- as.data.frame(TLSclusters@images$X0019329.R3.1658.2022.20240628.095421$centroids@coords)

p <- ggplot(centroid_coords, aes(x = x, y = y, color = TLScells@meta.data[["annotationRes0.3"]])) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 0.75) +
  theme_minimal()

p <- ggplot(centroid_coords, aes(x = x, y = y, color = TLScells@meta.data[["tls.cluster"]])) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(p)
```

```{r}
n_clusters <- length(unique(TLScells@meta.data[["annotationRes0.3"]]))
my_colors <- DiscretePalette(n_clusters, palette = "polychrome")

# Same as before, just add colors
centroid_coords <- as.data.frame(TLSclusters@images$X0019329.R3.1658.2022.20240628.095421$centroids@coords)
centroid_coords$cluster <- as.factor(TLScells@meta.data[["annotationRes0.3"]])

p <- ggplot(centroid_coords, aes(x = x, y = y, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 0.75) +
  scale_color_manual(values = my_colors) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(p)
```

See Sadafs paper: calculate scores for e.g. maturity, cytotoxicity, exhaustion and compare TLS clusters using statistical test

# Quantification of maturity markers FCER2, CR2 

```{r}
VlnPlot(TLScells, features = c("CR2", "FCER2", "CXCL13"), group.by = "tls.cluster", pt.size = 0)

expr_data <- FetchData(TLScells, vars = c("FCER2", "CR2", "CXCL13", "tls.cluster"))
head(expr_data)

plot_data <- expr_data %>%
  mutate(MaturityScore = rowMeans(select(., FCER2, CR2, CXCL13)))

plt <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(y = MaturityScore, x = tls.cluster, fill = tls.cluster)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 19) +
  #geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Maturation Score by TLS Region",
       subtitle = "Genes used: CR2, FCER2, CXCL13",
       y = "Average Expression Score",
       x = "TLS Region") +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 15),
        axis.title = element_text(size= 20),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 25),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position = "none")

ggsave(plt, file = paste0(fig_dir,"6_TLSregions_MaturityScore", ".png"), width = 10, height=10)

```

## average expression
```{r}
avg_expr <- AverageExpression(TLScells, assays = "Xenium", features = c("CR2", "FCER2", "CXCL13"))
avg_expr_df <- as.data.frame(avg_expr$Xenium)
avg_expr_df$gene <- rownames(avg_expr_df)
avg_expr_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(avg_expr_df, -gene, names_to = "cluster", values_to = "avg_expression")

ggplot(avg_expr_long, aes(x = gene, y = avg_expression, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Average activation marker Gene Expression")

#Heatmap
library(pheatmap)
avg_matrix <- avg_expr$Xenium
scaled_matrix <- t(scale(t(avg_matrix)))
pheatmap(scaled_matrix,
         cluster_rows = F,
         cluster_cols = F,
         display_numbers = TRUE,
         main = "Avg Expression Heatmap (z-scored)",
         color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(50))
```

```{r}
# Filter the two groups
group3 <- plot_data[plot_data$tls.cluster == "TLS3", "HEVscore"]
group11 <- plot_data[plot_data$tls.cluster == "TLS11", "HEVscore"]

TLS3 <- plot_data %>%
  filter(tls.cluster == "TLS3")

# Plot histograms or boxplots to visualize
ggplot(TLS3, aes(x = HEVscore))+
  geom_histogram(bins = 100) +
  scale_x_log10()

hist(group3, main = "TLS Cluster 3", xlab = "HEVscore")
hist(group11, main = "TLS Cluster 11", xlab = "HEVscore")



wilcox.test(HEVscore ~ tls.cluster, data = plot_data[plot_data$tls_cluster %in% c(3, 11),])

head(group3)
```
